title: Energizing Smoky Irish Chicken Grill
description: A winey and snappy post-workout Irish dish featuring hojicha, perfect for a quick and nourishing meal after a workout, with a smoky flavor from the grill.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together hojicha tea, red wine, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the chicken for 10-12 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the grill and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Use a lazy-susan-spinner to serve the dish and make it easy to pass and share.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
